comparators: one-sided one-sample t-test on species-specific rho values

interpretation.supported: Species-conditioning is the dominant protection against the deliberately strong between-species geographic confounding in this benchmark. Equal-species and pair-weighted matched-null tests are both calibrated in null cells; equal weighting modestly improves power over pair weighting in several weak-effect imbalanced cells, while a simple one-sample test on species-specific rho values is also reasonably calibrated and competitive in power.
not_supported: equal species weighting is always more powerful
one-sample testing of species rho is generally equivalent to matched-null calibration
superiority over hierarchical spatial models not tested here
